scope: B0 baseline observation only; no product modifications, commits, pushes, deletions or release

steps.title: Pin source executable inputs and dirty-state identity
steps.done_when: HEAD/source inputs/exe/fixtures match approved identities and unrelated edits are preserved
steps.verify: hash records and approved read-only preflight
steps.verify_cmd_candidate:
git status --short --branch
git rev-parse HEAD
# Bind and hash BASELINE source inputs and P03TestExe before genuine Gate B preview

steps.title: Observe fixed EXE and minimal physical H01 probe
steps.done_when: verified self-test/window outputs, actual adapter and human attempts at existing corner/keyboard paths recorded honestly
steps.verify: real stdout/stderr plus operator artifacts or explicit implementation gaps

steps.title: Run main Workspace domain regressions
steps.done_when: actual root Workspace test and all-target check output recorded for the approved code fingerprint
steps.verify: commands and full outputs, not POC zero-test count

steps.title: Observe physical two-monitor H01 baseline tasks
steps.done_when: G01/G02/G03/G08 have honest observed results or explicit implementation/evidence blockers
steps.verify: human operator device/DPI/pointer/keyboard/Narrator artifacts; no automatic signature

steps.title: Review observations and bound next repair
steps.done_when: issues classified, coverage limits recorded, one bounded next change proposed without implementation
steps.verify: review report with evidence hashes; remaining G groups retain NOT_RUN

if_then: If identity or approved scope differs, stop and regenerate the preview.
If a baseline task has an implementation gap, record it and select one bounded repair in a later Gate B.
If actual wgpu fails, distinguish device/session/backend error before changing GUI framework.
side_effects: Cargo may contact dependency sources and write caches/target; locked does not mean offline.
EXE commands open windows and allocate image/GPU resources; output capture and timeout must be bound before preview.
Human tasks may alter clipboard/DPI and create synthetic evidence only within the approved isolated directory.
genuine_cli_import_note: Use genuine init/template and check commands; candidate wrapper is not a drop-in .decision/plan.json and verify_cmd_candidate is not an executable approved verify_cmd.
